newsitem.title: SUDAN: Torrential rains lash Khartoum, nearby areas.
newsitem.headline: Torrential rains lash Khartoum, nearby areas.

text.p: Torrential rains lashed several areas in Sudan, destroying houses in the capital Khartoum and flooding eastern agricultural lands but there were no casualties, Sudanese newspapers said on Thursday.
They said the rains, which rose up to 59 millimetres (2.3 inches) in some areas, fell at dawn on Wednesday isolating several parts of Khartoum and uprooting trees.
A Saudi plane flying over the Darushab and Kadaro areas of Khartoum North alerted the civil defence to encroaching floods but the water diverted its path and drained in the Nile, the papers added.
The Sudan al-Hadith newspaper quoted the civil defence director, Major-General Babiker Ibrahim, as saying the situation was stable.
Some 15 people were killed and several houses destroyed in heavy rains in Geili north of Khartoum earlier this this month.
